name: Combat Experience (Combat)
body:
You have learned to make greater use out of your accumulated martial knowledge and leverage the flow of battle to your advantage.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +2 and 2 ranks in Knowledge (history) or Profession (soldier).

Benefit: You can use this feat a number of times per day equal to 1 + your highest mental ability score modifier. You may spend an immediate action to gain one of the following benefits:

Gain a +1 competence bonus to an attack roll you make while that attack roll has applied a penalty of at least -1 due to the use of one of your combat feats.
Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC against one attack roll made against you while your AC is currently benefiting from one of your combat feats. This circumstance bonus applies even to your touch and flat-footed AC.
Gain a +1 competence bonus to your saving throw roll while that saving throw is currently benefiting from one of your combat feats.

For every 4 ranks above 2 you have in either Knowledge (history) or Profession (soldier), whichever you have more ranks in, you increase the bonus granted through the use of this feat by +1.

Special: Whenever you use Combat Experience during a round, you must wait at least 1d4 rounds before you can use this feat again.
